hypothesis: The two remaining UNRESOLVED issue-938 reproduction-isolation hypotheses are decided by partitioning the exact-geometry hybrid eigensystem's residual non-convergent >200 Hz modal tail per mode into conditioning-polluted (sliver-localized) versus ordinary-spectrum classes, projecting each class's signed contribution onto every failing adjacent-pair observable delta, and rescoring the frozen gates on a sliver-excluded counterfactual. A mass-floor conditioning-controlled eigensystem variant independently tests whether the inflated tail eigenvalues are causally produced by tiny cut-cell nodal masses. A Weyl modal-density descriptor bounds whether the surviving ordinary-spectrum tail content is physical room resonance or discretization-realization content.
preregistration: Commit and push this fixed diagnostic plan to the feature branch before any new eigensystem census, attribution, subset rescoring, or conditioning-variant numeric execution.

original.source_receiver: exact original SHA-pinned vox_out.h5/comms_out.h5 native 8x8 indices and weights; assets are provisioned by upstream sim_setup on the frozen sloped fixture (8-vertex rigid wedge, rh=50, Tc=20, fmax=100, impulse insig, duration 0.25 s, Nprocs=1, fcc_flag=0, draw_vox=0) identical to scripts/run_rev71_other_nonconvergence_diagnostic.py and are accepted only when both pinned SHA-256 values match the frozen records
original.q0: exact original 8 sample native impulse in_sigs[:,0]; all later samples 0

mfem_self_convergence_thresholds.pair: MFEM refinement 2 to refinement 3, frozen in benchmarks/acoustics/r130d_general3d_validation_plan.json acceptance.reference_self_convergence

method.fixed_operator: same symmetric conservative Cartesian full wet 5point + physical roof cut-Q1 flux, full consistent mass, x conforming-roof P1 tensor operators, no changes; identical construction to the frozen endpoint-attribution axis
method.axis_l1_full_mode_localization_census: per grid, recompute the complete generalized hybrid eigensystem; for every yz factor mode record eigenfrequency and M-mass fractions on each frozen support set: nodal support area < {0.01,0.05,0.10,0.50}*h^2 and true-roof distance <= {1,2}*h (same support-set definitions as the committed CFL eigenvector localization axis)
method.axis_l1_mode_classes: ordered first-match classification of every yz factor mode: sliver_lt010 iff M-mass fraction on area<0.10*h^2 nodes >0.5; else sliver_lt050 iff fraction on area<0.50*h^2 nodes >0.5; else roof_le1h iff fraction on roof<=1h nodes >0.5; else bulk. Every 3-D mode inherits its yz factor's class (x factors are bulk conforming-P1 by construction)
method.axis_l1_band_census: per frequency band x class: mode count and summed absolute signed 40/80 modal contribution, same frozen band edges [0,100,200,400,800,1600,3200,inf)
method.axis_l2_signed_delta_attribution: for each of the four adjacent pairs, partition every mode of each grid into the four classes and apply the committed signed real projection Re(conj(D)*d_j)/|D|^2 so the per-class fractions sum to exactly 1; report fractions per class per signed bin per pair
method.axis_l3_non_sliver_counterfactual: reconstruct each grid's signed 40/80 transfer with sliver-class modes removed (terms masked to zero, never deleted from the operator), rescore all four adjacent pairs x all three frozen gates, and also report the sliver-only reconstruction; the unmodified full reconstruction must re-bind to the frozen signed transfer at relative tolerance 2e-8 before any subset is scored
method.axis_l4_mass_floor_mechanism_check: for each grid, floor the positive diagonal yz mass at 0.01*h^2, recompute the complete yz generalized spectrum only, and report post-floor yz lambda_max, the collapse factor versus the unmodified yz lambda_max, and the median/max relative eigenfrequency shift of band <=200 Hz modes (index-matched, ordering-preserving); spectrum-level mechanism check only: no observable reconstruction, transfer, or gate is computed on the floored system
method.axis_l5_weyl_descriptor: per band x grid, report non-sliver mode count versus the Weyl asymptotic Neumann count N=(4*pi/3)*V*(hi^3-lo^3)/c^3 for V=56 m^3 (half-open bands, the open top band reports count only), as a physicality descriptor of the ordinary-spectrum tail
method.axis_l6_mfem_gate_reevaluation: evaluation-only on the committed mfem_manifest of r130d_reproduction_isolation_diagnostic_summary.json: compute the MFEM refinement 2 to 3 signed 40/80 transfer metrics against the frozen reference_self_convergence thresholds, restate the canonical PFFDTD side, and re-issue the mfem_pffdtd_cross_solver_gate status with its precise blocker; no new MFEM runs are required by this axis, but if the WSL2 MFEM toolchain is executable the three refinement legs may be re-executed for an execution_freshness flag and any numeric difference versus the committed manifest fails closed
method.all_mode_frozen_signed_reference: previously committed unchanged full hybrid 40/80Hz signed values; require relative agreement 2e-8 before any class partition is scored
method.pair_signed_difference_projection: Re(conj(full coarse-fine difference)*one class coarse-fine difference)/abs(full coarse-fine difference)^2; signed and can exceed 1 or be negative; all class fractions must sum to 1 per pair per bin
method.no_operator_or_contract_modification: the sliver-excluded counterfactual and the mass-floor variant are diagnostic decompositions of the unchanged committed eigensystem; neither redefines any acceptance contract

decision_semantics.failing_pairs: adjacent pairs whose full-spectrum three-gate result fails under the frozen thresholds (the residual non-convergent tail under test)
decision_semantics.sliver_delta_share: sum over the two sliver classes' signed projected delta-fractions, aggregated over all failing pairs and both signed bins as sum(Re(conj(D)*d_sliver))/sum(|D|^2)
decision_semantics.non_sliver_delta_share: same aggregation over roof_le1h and bulk classes

fem_conditioning_pollution_verdicts.SUPPORTED_DRIVER: sliver_delta_share >= 0.8, OR the non-sliver counterfactual turns every failing gate of at least one previously failing pair to PASS
fem_conditioning_pollution_verdicts.SUPPORTED_PRESENT_NOT_DRIVER: sliver-dominated tail modes demonstrably exist (enrichment of top tail modes on sliver sets >= 10x baseline) but sliver_delta_share < 0.2 and no counterfactual gate flips to PASS
fem_conditioning_pollution_verdicts.REJECTED: no sliver-dominated tail modes exist (enrichment < 3x) AND mass-floor collapse factor < 2
fem_conditioning_pollution_verdicts.UNRESOLVED: asset binding, eigensystem caps, or reference re-binding fails

true_physical_resonance_verdicts.SUPPORTED_PHYSICAL_UNDER_RESOLVED: non_sliver_delta_share >= 0.8 AND the bulk class band counts in the failing pairs' delta-carrying bands are within the declared Weyl window [0.25,4] of the asymptotic count (modes a real room must carry, rendered under dispersion)
true_physical_resonance_verdicts.SUPPORTED_UNRESOLVED_PHYSICALITY: non_sliver_delta_share >= 0.8 but the Weyl descriptor is outside the window; recorded honestly as non-sliver realization-dependent content
true_physical_resonance_verdicts.UNRESOLVED: asset binding, eigensystem caps, or reference re-binding fails

mfem_pffdtd_cross_solver_gate_verdicts.BLOCKED: self-convergence has not re-passed on both solvers (status quo unless new evidence changes either side)
mfem_pffdtd_cross_solver_gate_verdicts.BLOCKED_BOTH_SIDES_NONCONVERGENT: PFFDTD canonical side remains SELF_CONVERGENCE_FAILED AND the MFEM refinement 2 to 3 committed metrics fail the frozen reference thresholds
mfem_pffdtd_cross_solver_gate_verdicts.ELIGIBLE: both sides' frozen self-convergence re-pass (not reachable on this axis; canonical PFFDTD state is unchanged)

honesty: This axis decomposes and rescores the unchanged committed hybrid eigensystem; it does not amend or rescale the canonical original outcome: original staircase contract remains SELF_CONVERGENCE_FAILED, product remains NO_GO for the original observable. A class-attribution counterfactual is evidence about mechanism, not a requalified acceptance contract; the mass-floor variant is a spectrum-level conditioning check and is never scored as a solver. UNRESOLVED with the precise blocker recorded is an acceptable terminal outcome; fabricated resolution is not.
expected_runtime: under 25 minutes on the Windows box once the SHA-pinned original sim setups are provisioned; the optional MFEM leg adds about 5 minutes when the WSL2 toolchain is already built
